title: Internal: handling procedure for issuing a corrected Bill of Lading as a new set of originals
content:
## Scope of application

Under the Bills of Lading and Transport Documents product, once a correction that required the originals back has been applied, the corrected document is issued as the next set, the set number plus one, carrying no issuance fee, and the originals of that set are put into circulation.

## Entry conditions

The corrected set is issued only when two facts already stand on the record.

1. The originals still in circulation on the document have come down to zero because every original of the previous set has been lodged back with the line.
2. The correction fee due on the correction request the set carries has already been booked.

The second fact ensures that the corrected set leaves the desk with its documentation account complete. When no fee is due on the carried request because the correction was caused by the line's own keying error, which the product's correction rules never charge, the second fact is met without a fee row. Where either fact does not stand, the corrected set is not issued.

## Business effect

One call makes the given set the set in force on the document, dates its issue on the current day, adds the given number of originals to the originals in circulation and records the originals of the new set as put into circulation in the documentation history. No issuance fee is booked. The customer then sees the new set number, the new date of issue and the originals outstanding.

## How it is invoked

issue_corrected_set_a7062696 is an internal desk tool; the agent must first unlock it and then call it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| bl_id | Reference number of the transport document being reissued as a corrected set, as returned by the transport document lookup | Id text |
| request_id | Reference number of the correction request the corrected set carries, as returned by the documentation service request lookup | Id text |
| bl_set_sequence | Number of the new set of originals: 1 for the first set issued, 2 for a replacement or switch set | Whole number, no decimals |
| originals_count | How many original documents of the new set are put into circulation | Whole number, 0 or more, no decimals |

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the documentation entry reference of the originals put into circulation (an opaque text id beginning "boi_"), the transport document reference, the correction request carried, the new set number, the number of originals issued and the originals now outstanding. The appearance of that sentence is the success signal.

## Points of judgement

- **Question:** Is an issuance fee charged again for the corrected set? **Answer:** No; the corrected set carries no issuance fee.
- **Question:** The correction on the carried request was caused by the line's own keying error and no fee row exists. **Answer:** The fee fact is met without a fee row, so the absence of a row does not hold the corrected set back.
- **Question:** One original of the previous set has not come back. **Answer:** The first fact does not stand, so the corrected set is not issued.
